records.title: TQTS-Bench: A Multi-Syntax Benchmark for Text-to-Query over Time-Series Databases
records.reason: TQTS-Bench is a benchmark for LLM text-to-time-series-database querying; it evaluates task quality rather than inference cost.

records.title: Understanding On-Policy Distillation: A Mechanistic Interpretability Perspective via Sparse Crosscoders
records.reason: This paper uses sparse crosscoders to interpret what on-policy distillation changes internally; it is an interpretability study, not an inference method.

records.title: Cheap to Hypothesize, Costly to Verify: The Defense Surface of Agentic Vulnerability Discovery
records.reason: RedHerring is a cybersecurity defense that intentionally diverts agent verification effort to safe decoys; resource diversion is an attack/defense outcome, not inference efficiency.

records.title: ROSS: Relearning from Self-Generated Rollouts through Selective Supervision
records.reason: ROSS is a post-training method that learns from generated rollouts; the abstract does not present reduced inference cost as a contribution.

records.title: Learning from Teacher Continuations at Student States
records.reason: Learning from teacher continuations is a post-training/distillation method; it does not describe a serving or inference-efficiency technique.
